layout_note: FSE 2025 Zenodo replication package (10.5281/zenodo.15121080). Curated npm + GitHub (WoC) samples, precomputed dep-graph metrics for RQ1 panel regression, and precomputed RQ2 intervention risk tables. Raw package-lock dumps (~300GB) are NOT included.
copy_note: The shared artifact is read-only. Copy selected CSVs/notebooks into project/ before modifying. Write experiment outputs under project/ or results/.

instance_counts.note: Zip 524MB compressed; extracted ~2.4GB. RQ1 uses 10k npm + 10k GitHub samples with precomputed metrics. RQ2 uses data/intervention/* precomputes (full graph simulation takes days).

abbreviations.woc: GitHub repositories from World of Code (not necessarily published to npm)

python_environment.note: Prepared automatically at container startup. System node/npm (and Rscript when available) are also on PATH. Author conda env name is pinfloat (environment.yml).

not_provided.raw_package_lock_dumps: Author package-lock.json dumps are ~300GB and intentionally omitted; use precomputed sample_depgraph_metrics_*.csv instead.
not_provided.full_npm_registry_mirror: Prefer curated CSVs/graphs in data/; do not scrape the live registry at ecosystem scale unless explicitly needed and rate-limited.
not_provided.libraries_io_api_key: Libraries.io live API access is optional; the replication package already includes the processed study data.
